integrity: The spectral projector calculation, multiplicities, distance polynomials and symbolic identities appear in RESULT.md, with independent finite examples in verify.py. Novelty remains subject to broader eigenmatrix-theorem comparisons.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on existence of generalized quadrangles of balanced order (q,q) with integer q>=2; no claim for unbalanced parameters or instantaneous mixing; numerical graph reconstructions for q=2,3 do not prove the infinite theorem.
title: Full-rank quantum Cesàro mixing on generalized-quadrangle incidence graphs
